lines.en: label amidate35:
I tap on Ami’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Ami 的名字,等她接听。

lines.en: I’ve yet to see her come home with a new bathing suit, so unless she’s been hiding it from me for some reason, I doubt she’s gone to the mall yet.
lines.zh: 我还没见她带着新泳衣回家,所以除非她有什么原因藏着掖着,我猜她还没去过商场。

lines.en: I’m also aware that roughly half of the reason she’s been abstaining is due to the fact that I have not yet invited her.
lines.zh: 我也清楚,她忍到现在,大约有一半原因在于我还没开口邀请。

lines.en: So, without really knowing what else to do with my day, I decide to take Ami on a little trip.
lines.zh: 所以,在今天实在没别的事可做的情况下,我决定带 Ami 来一场小出行。

lines.en: It’s amazing how easily you can get me to actually do things when I know I won’t have to pay for them.
lines.zh: 真是神奇——只要知道不用我掏钱,你让我干啥我都乐意。

lines.en: : Sensei! I was just thinking about you.
lines.zh: : Sensei!我正好在想你了。

lines.en: : What? No way. What a strange turn of events.
lines.zh: : 什么?不会吧。剧情走向真是奇妙。

lines.en: : Ha ha ha. That was so funny I forgot to laugh.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈。你这个笑话好笑得我都忘了笑。

lines.en: : But...you just-
lines.zh: : 可是……你不是——

lines.en: : So, what’s up? Are you just calling to hear my voice or are you looking for some Ami-time?
lines.zh: : 那么说吧,什么事?你是单纯想听听我的声音,还是想来一场「Ami 专属时间」?

lines.en: : Ami-time sounds exhausting. I was just going to see if you wanted to take off your clothes in a dressing room for me.
lines.zh: : 「Ami 专属时间」听着就累。我只是想问问,你愿不愿意在试衣间里为我脱衣服。

lines.en: : In public?! But that’s-
lines.zh: : 在大庭广众?!可是那——

lines.en: : Oh wait, is this about the swimsuit?
lines.zh: : 哦等等,是为了泳衣的事吧?

lines.en: : You bet.
lines.zh: : 被你猜中了。

lines.en: : Tch...
: Was that frustration I just heard?
lines.zh: : 我刚才是不是听到了一丝恼火?

lines.en: : Nope! No frustration at all!
lines.zh: : 没有!完全没有恼火!

lines.en: : I’m actually on the bus headed home right now, but I can just get off at the mall instead if you want to meet there!
lines.zh: : 其实我现在正在回家的公交上,不过要是你想约在商场碰头,我可以直接在那站下车!

lines.en: : I’m really sorry we don’t get to travel together but-
lines.zh: : 真抱歉我们没办法同路——

lines.en: : Sure, I’ll see you there.
lines.zh: : 行,商场见。

lines.en: : Wait. I was about to say something really cute and-
lines.zh: : 等等。我本来准备说一句超可爱的话,然后——

lines.en: I hang up the phone after I finish making plans with Ami and start heading over to the bus stop.
lines.zh: 和 Ami 定好计划后我挂断电话,朝公交站走去。

lines.en: scene black
The bus schedule is pretty packed around this time of day, so I imagine I won’t have to wait long.
lines.zh: 这个时段的公交班次相当密集,我想不用等太久。

lines.en: And since Ami’s already on one heading back from work, I doubt that the one I get on will just so happen to have her sitting there acting all surprised once I reach the top step.
lines.zh: 而且 Ami 已经在下班回来的车上,我猜我上的那辆车,不至于恰好让她坐在那里、在我踏上车门时表演「惊讶」。

lines.en: Yeah. Nothing convenient like that would ever happen to someone like me.
lines.zh: 是啊。那种方便的巧合,永远轮不到我头上。

lines.en: scene mall2
Huh. I thought for sure that narrating a line like that was an omen for things to come, but apparently not.
lines.zh: 呵。我还笃定,念出那样一句旁白是接下来剧情的预兆,结果显然不是。

lines.en: I make it to the mall after a decently quick bus ride in which an older woman (So old that I didn’t even contemplate the idea of having sex with her as more than just a passing thought) fell asleep on my shoulder.
lines.zh: 一段相当快的车程后,我到了商场。途中一位老太太(年纪大到「和她上床」这个念头连从我脑中飘过的资格都没有)在我肩上睡着了。

lines.en: I didn’t bother waking her up, though, considering she will likely die in the next several years and needs all the rest she can get until then.
lines.zh: 不过我没打扰她,毕竟她接下来几年里多半就要走了,在那之前能多睡一会儿是多久。

lines.en: To sleep before the big sleep.
lines.zh: 在长眠之前先打个盹。

lines.en: Oh, what a sleep that must be.
lines.zh: 哦,那必然是一场酣睡。

lines.en: if amimaster.lower() in ["sensei"]:
: About time you showed up, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 你可算来了,Sensei!

lines.en: scene amimalltwo1
else:
: About time, [amimaster]!
lines.zh: : 你可算来了,[amimaster]!

lines.en: scene amimalltwo1
: What do you think you’re doing, calling me that in public?
lines.zh: : 你在公共场合这么叫我,自己掂量掂量?

lines.en: : What’s wrong? It’s not like anybody else is paying attention.
lines.zh: : 怎么了?反正也没别人注意。

lines.en: : And I like calling you that. It reminds me of how close we are.
lines.zh: : 而且我喜欢这么叫你。这让我想起我们有多亲密。

lines.en: : I mean, I don’t care. I just don’t want someone getting the wrong idea.
lines.zh: : 我倒是不在乎。我只是不想让人产生误会。

lines.en: : Blah blah blah. Who cares what people think? We’re here to get our love all over each other and stuff. I’m gonna call you what I want to call you.
lines.zh: : 啦啦啦。谁在乎别人怎么想?我们今天是来把爱互相蹭满全身什么的。我想怎么叫你就怎么叫你。

lines.en: : Can you define exactly what you mean by “getting our love all over each other?”
lines.zh: : 你能精确定义一下,什么叫「把爱互相蹭满全身」吗?

lines.en: : Nope!
lines.zh: : 不能!

lines.en: : How was the bus ride over?
lines.zh: : 车上旅途还顺利吗?

lines.en: : I thought for a second that you were going to mysteriously appear on the same bus as me after our call, but it just didn’t happen.
lines.zh: : 我还有一秒钟以为,你会在通话之后神秘地出现在我同一辆车上,结果什么都没发生。

lines.en: : Screw the bus, what happened to your hair?
lines.zh: : 公交先放一边,你的头发怎么了?

lines.en: scene amimalltwo2
: Huh? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 嗯?什么意思?

lines.en: : Are you talking about my bangs?
lines.zh: : 你是说我的刘海?

lines.en: : Yeah. Aren’t they normally straight? How did you get them to...not be straight anymore?
lines.zh: : 对。平时不是直的吗?你是怎么让它……不直了的?

lines.en: scene amimalltwo3
: The same way Maya can eat more than her body weight in food and Ayane can materialize guns and giant bananas out of thin air.
lines.zh: : 和 Maya 能吃下超过自身体重的食物、以及 Ayane 能凭空变出枪和巨型香蕉,是同一个原理。

lines.en: : Cute girl magic!
lines.zh: : 可爱女孩魔法!

lines.en: : Oh, okay.
lines.zh: : 哦,原来如此。

lines.en: : Well that explains everything.
lines.zh: : 那就说得通了。

lines.en: scene amimalltwo4
: Yup! Cute girls are special creatures who normal laws and rules don’t apply to!
lines.zh: : 没错!可爱女孩是特殊生物,普通法则与规则对她们统统不适用!

lines.en: : So you should never question things like that because it won’t make any difference whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 所以这种事永远不必深究,因为深究也不会有任何结果。

lines.en: : Hey, if you want to have magical bangs, that’s your right. You can have whatever kind of bangs you want, Ami.
lines.zh: : 好吧,你要是想要魔法刘海,那是你的权利。你想要什么样的刘海都行,Ami。

lines.en: scene amimalltwo5
: So, anyway!
lines.zh: : 那么,总之!

lines.en: : I wanted to check Le Vetefrenchwordstore where Chika works because they normally have a small selection of off-season stuff.
lines.zh: : 我想去逛逛 Le Vetefrenchwordstore,就是 Chika 打工的那家,他们一般会留一点过季的货。

lines.en: : But I don’t like the way Chika looks at you, so you can just wait in the corridor while I pop in and out really quick.
lines.zh: : 但我不喜欢 Chika 看你的眼神,所以你就在走廊等着,我进去一下马上出来。

lines.en: : I am not waiting outside while you talk to Chika.
lines.zh: : 你和 Chika 说话,我可不在外面等。

lines.en: scene amimalltwo6
: But what if she tries to steal your penis like Sada Abe?!
lines.zh: : 可万一她像阿部定那样,要把你的 penis 偷走怎么办?!

lines.en: : Who?
scene amimalltwo7
: Weebnote...kind of!
lines.zh: : Weebnote……差不多!

lines.en: : Sada Abe was a geisha and prostitute who lived from 1905 - 1971 and ultimately became famous for suffocating her lover to death!
lines.zh: : 阿部定是一位艺伎兼娼妇,生于 1905 至 1971 年,最终因勒死自己的情人而留名!

lines.en: : Well, the suffocating part wasn’t what made her famous. But what came after did!
lines.zh: : 嗯,让她留名的其实不是勒杀。而是那之后的事!

lines.en: : You see, Sada Abe took it upon herself to sever the penis of the man she loved more than anything else in the world and then carried it around for weeks afterward!
lines.zh: : 你看,阿部定亲手割下了她世界上最爱的那个男人的 penis,然后带着它四处走了好几个星期!

lines.en: : Not all good things last forever, though. Abe was eventually sentenced and spent five years in prison.
lines.zh: : 不过好事难长久。阿部定最终被判处有罪,在狱中服刑五年。

lines.en: : If someone did something like that today, they’d likely spend much longer in jail. So don’t go cutting any penises off, kids!
lines.zh: : 要是今天有人干这种事,刑期恐怕会长得多。所以小朋友们,千万不要去割任何人的 penis!

lines.en: scene amimalltwo8
Molly proceeds to walk away from us without saying another word and disappears into some video game store.
lines.zh: Molly 丢下这句话便径直走开,消失在某家游戏店里。

lines.en: : Well, that was weird.
lines.zh: : 呃,这真怪。

lines.en: : Yes, but I feel like we learned a valuable lesson.
lines.zh: : 是怪,但我觉得我们学到了宝贵的一课。

lines.en: scene amimalltwo9
: Did you really need an Irish girl to show up and tell you that cutting off penises is wrong?
lines.zh: : 你真的需要一位爱尔兰女孩现身,来告诉你割 penis 是不对的吗?

lines.en: : Not that. The lesson we learned is cute girl magic is real and can also cause people to show up exactly when they’re needed.
lines.zh: : 不是这个。我们学到的教训是:可爱女孩魔法是真的,而且还能让关键人物恰好在需要她的时刻登场。

lines.en: : But...then the buses-
lines.zh: : 可是……那公交车——

lines.en: : Never mind that, Ami. Let’s just start heading over to Le Vetefrenchwordstore and get your clothes off.
lines.zh: : 那个就别管了,Ami。我们直接去 Le Vetefrenchwordstore,把你的衣服脱了吧。

lines.en: scene amimalltwo10
: Yeah! Stripping in a public dressing room with my [uncle]!
lines.zh: : 好耶!和我的 [uncle] 在公共试衣间里宽衣解带!

lines.en: : Please don’t yell things like that...
lines.zh: : 求你别大喊这种话……

lines.en: scene black
scene amimalltwo11
: Ah! Sensei! I had no idea you were going to show up today!
lines.zh: : 啊!Sensei!我都不知道你今天会来!

lines.en: : Hey, Chika. It is for my safety and yours that I think you should only minimally acknowledge my existence today.
lines.zh: : 嗨,Chika。为了你我的安全,我建议你今天尽量淡化我的存在感。

lines.en: : Understood!
lines.zh: : 明白!

lines.en: scene amimalltwo12
: Hey, Ami! Out on a date with your [uncle] today?
lines.zh: : 嘿,Ami!今天和你 [uncle] 约会来啦?

lines.en: : It’s not a-
lines.zh: : 这才不是——

lines.en: : Yes. We are on a date. That is what is happening.
lines.zh: : 对。我们在约会。目前发生的就是这件事。

lines.en: : Fun! Making him buy you something nice?
lines.zh: : 有趣!是让他给你买好东西吗?

lines.en: scene amimalltwo13
: Actually...I was kind of hoping you still had some stuff from summer in stock.
lines.zh: : 其实……我比较想看看你们有没有夏装库存。

lines.en: : She’s also using her own money. I would never force my [niece] to wear a swimsuit in the winter just for the fun of it.
lines.zh: : 她用的是自己的钱。我可不会为了好玩,强迫我的 [niece] 大冬天试穿泳衣。

lines.en: scene amimalltwo14
: Why would you say something that suspicious when that isn’t even close to what’s actually happening?
lines.zh: : 明明完全不是这么回事,你为什么要说这么可疑的话?

lines.en: : Yeah, that just makes me think that’s a thing you would do, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 对啊,这么一说,反倒显得这就是你会干的事,Sensei。

lines.en: : You know, I’m really not sure why I said that.
lines.zh: : 说真的,我也不知道我为什么要说那句。

lines.en: : Please continue minimally acknowledging my existence.
lines.zh: : 请继续淡化我的存在。

lines.en: : ...Okay.
scene amimalltwo15
: Anyway, yeah. We’ve still got some summer stuff. It’s all on clearance right now too since no one’s buying swimsuits.
lines.zh: : 总之,嗯。夏装我们还有一些。而且现在全部清仓,反正没人冬天买泳衣。

lines.en: : So as long as you think you’ll be able to maintain your figure or...size until beach season rolls back around, buying one now is totally fine.
lines.zh: : 所以只要你觉得自己能撑到下一个海滩季、身材或……尺寸不发生变化,现在买完全没问题。

lines.en: : Oh, the last thing I’m worried about is growing out of it. That won’t be happening.
lines.zh: : 哦,我最不担心的就是「长大穿不下」。那种事不会发生。

lines.en: So much for holding out hope on becoming “sultry and sexy...”
lines.zh: 「妖艳又性感」什么的,看来是彻底没指望了……

lines.en: : Cool! Then yeah, come to the back with me and I’ll show you where everything is.
lines.zh: : 好!那就跟我来后面,我带你看看都在哪。

lines.en: : Great!
lines.zh: : 太好了!

lines.en: : Oh, would you mind if Sensei came into the dressing room with me, though?
lines.zh: : 哦对了,要是 Sensei 跟我一起进试衣间,你介意吗?

lines.en: scene amimalltwo16
: Uhh...
: Ami, why? Why would you say this?
lines.zh: : Ami,为什么?你为什么要说这个?

lines.en: : What’s wrong, Sensei? We’re family. You’ve seen me in my underwear tons of times.
lines.zh: : 怎么了嘛,Sensei?我们是家人。你看过我穿内衣的次数多到数不清。

lines.en: : Don’t tell me you’ve been looking at me strangely, have you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会一直在用奇怪的眼神看我吧?

lines.en: This fucking demon.
lines.zh: 这个该死的恶魔。

lines.en: : I mean...there have definitely been dads who have helped their kid daughters in the dressing room before but...
lines.zh: : 我是说……确实有爸爸帮小女儿在试衣间里换衣服的先例,但是……

lines.en: scene amimalltwo17
: Oh...I understand...
lines.zh: : 哦……我明白了……

lines.en: : Sensei’s raised me since I was a little girl, but...since he isn’t technically related to me that way...
lines.zh: : Sensei 从我小的时候就把我养大,但……严格来说他没有血缘……

lines.en: This fucking demon...
lines.zh: 这个该死的恶魔……

lines.en: : Wait, no! I didn’t mean it like that! It’s totally fine if that’s...what you need!
lines.zh: : 啊不是!我不是那个意思!如果那是……你们需要的,完全没问题!

lines.en: : But it’s...kind of...definitely a little weird since he’s an adult and...you’re a [teenage]girl...
lines.zh: : 只是……多少……肯定有一点点怪,毕竟他是成年人,而……你是 [teenage] 女孩……

lines.en: scene amimalltwo18
: Yay! Thank you, Chika!
lines.zh: : 耶!谢谢你,Chika!

lines.en: : Uhh...yeah...
: Just...probably don’t say anything about this to anybody else.
lines.zh: : 你们最好……别跟其他任何人提这事。

lines.en: scene black
Chika leads Ami to the back of the store and directs her to a bin full of items that no one picked up during summer.
lines.zh: Chika 把 Ami 领到店铺后侧,指向一个箱子——里面塞满了整个夏天无人问津的商品。

lines.en: I’m sure they would have had a chance to sell if the seasons didn’t abruptly change, but that’s beside the point.
lines.zh: 要不是季节说变就变,它们本来是有机会卖掉的,不过这无关紧要。

lines.en: Ami grabs a few swimsuits, holding them up to her tiny body and closely judging whether or not she will embarrass herself by attempting to put them on.
lines.zh: Ami 抓起几件泳衣,举到自己娇小的身体前,认真评估穿上它们会不会让自己当场社死。

lines.en: Suffice it to say, most of the swimsuits wind up right back in the bin.
lines.zh: 直说了吧,大部分泳衣最终都回到了箱子里。

lines.en: But, eventually, she finds a few she likes and heads into the dressing room.
lines.zh: 但最终,她挑出了几件喜欢的,走进了试衣间。

lines.en: I don’t follow right away because, even though Chika gave us permission, it still feels fucking weird.
lines.zh: 我没有立刻跟进去——虽然 Chika 点头放行了,这依然他妈的感觉很怪。

lines.en: But the second Chika is distracted by another customer, I seize the opportunity to join Ami and see what she looks like in a “less childish” bathing suit...
lines.zh: 但 Chika 一被其他客人缠住,我立刻抓住机会溜进试衣间,看看 Ami 穿上「不那么幼稚」的泳衣是什么样……

lines.en: scene amimalltwo19
: Finally...
lines.zh: : 可算……

lines.en: The answer: Still pretty childish.
lines.zh: 答案是:还是相当幼稚。

lines.en: : Yes, sorry for not being brazen enough to do the thing that one of your classmates said right to our faces is weird and socially unacceptable.
lines.zh: : 是,抱歉,我没有大胆到去做某个同学刚刚当着我们的面说又怪又为社会所不容的事。

lines.en: : Why do you always care so much about what is “socially acceptable?”
lines.zh: : 你为什么总是这么在意「社会容不容许」?

lines.en: : Ami, I am one of the last people who should ever be aligned with social acceptance.
lines.zh: : Ami,放眼天下,我最没有资格和「社会认可」站在一起。

lines.en: : But when you’re an adult male in my position, you need to be a little careful when it comes to certain things.
lines.zh: : 但像我这样处境的成年男性,在某些事情上,还是得小心一点。

lines.en: : Like following your [niece] into a dressing room?
lines.zh: : 比如,跟着 [niece] 进试衣间?

lines.en: : Like following my [niece] into a dressing room.
lines.zh: : 比如,跟着我的 [niece] 进试衣间。

lines.en: : You look really cute, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你看上去真的很可爱。

lines.en: scene amimalltwo20
: Really?! I don’t look like I’m trying too hard?!
lines.zh: : 真的?!我不显得用力过猛?!

lines.en: I will never get over how convenient it is to just dodge difficult conversations by telling Ami she is cute.
lines.zh: 夸 Ami 一句「可爱」就能绕开所有艰难对话,这招的便利性我永远惊叹不已。

lines.en: If I had a dollar for every time I’ve taken advantage of that, I could probably buy her every single swimsuit in her cart right now.
lines.zh: 要是我每次薅这招都能收一块钱,我现在大概已经把她购物车里的每一件泳衣都买下来了。

lines.en: Also, it definitely helps that I’m not even lying in telling her that.
lines.zh: 更何况,我对她说这话时甚至完全没撒谎。

lines.en: if ami_virgin == False:
In fact, if Chika wasn’t working right now, I’d probably even toy with the idea of taking things a little further with Ami for a few minutes.
lines.zh: 事实上,要不是 Chika 正在上班,我可能会认真考虑让事情再往前推进一步,推上几分钟。

lines.en: Obviously, I’m not going to do that, though.
lines.zh: 当然,我不会那么做。

lines.en: Because not only would that be socially unacceptable, I’m pretty sure having sex in the mall is entirely illegal.
lines.zh: 因为那不仅为社会所不容,我很确定在商场里做那种事是彻头彻尾的违法行为。

lines.en: And I refuse to live the rest of my alternate but also potentially not alternate (?) life in jail.
lines.zh: 而我拒绝在我这段平行、但说不定也不算平行(?)的余生里蹲监狱。

lines.en: else:
Sure, I try not to view Ami in a sexual light because of...reasons. But it’s absolutely undeniable that she appeals to me in a multitude of ways.
lines.zh: 诚然,出于……某些原因,我尽量不用那种眼光看 Ami。但她对我的吸引力是多维度的,这一点无可否认。

lines.en: There are just certain things you should always be able to say no to, though.
lines.zh: 只是有些事,你永远都应该有能力说「不」。

lines.en: I just wish those things weren’t so hard all of the time.
lines.zh: 我只是希望这些「不」,不要每次都那么难说出口。

lines.en: scene amimalltwo21
: Um...I’ll probably just wind up buying this one, then...
lines.zh: : 那个……那我大概就把这件买了吧……

lines.en: : Did you even try the other ones on yet?
lines.zh: : 其他几件你都没试吗?

lines.en: : Yeah. I tried a few of the other ones while you were waiting outside, but this is the one I thought looked the best.
lines.zh: : 试了。你在外面等着的时候我试了几件,但这件我觉得最好看。

lines.en: : And having you call me cute is...kind of all the validation I need anyway.
lines.zh: : 而且你夸我可爱……这种认可对我来说已经足够了。

lines.en: : I mean, I always think you’re cute, so my word should probably be taken with a grain of salt.
lines.zh: : 呃,我一直都觉得你可爱,所以我的评价基本可以当作废话处理。

lines.en: scene amimalltwo22
: And...And the ponytail? Is that good too?
lines.zh: : 还有……还有马尾呢?也可以吗?

lines.en: : My hair goes all over the place in the water and having it bundled up in one tail instead of two might not look as good, but-
lines.zh: : 下水之后头发会到处乱飘,扎成一条马尾可能不如双马尾好看,但是——

lines.en: : It looks great.
lines.zh: : 好看极了。

lines.en: scene amimalltwo23
: Okay...then yeah...I’m gonna get this one...
lines.zh: : 那……好……我就买这件……

lines.en: : What’s with you acting all bashful all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 你怎么突然扭捏起来了?

lines.en: : Like five minutes ago, you were manipulating Chika into just letting me in here.
lines.zh: : 五分钟前,你还在操纵 Chika 放我进来。

lines.en: : What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 怎么回事?

lines.en: if ami_virgin == True:
scene amimalltwo24
: Just...feeling a little strange now that you’re in here is all.
lines.zh: : 只是……你进来之后,感觉有点奇怪而已。

lines.en: : Trying to make sure I don’t say or do anything that might get us in trouble.
lines.zh: : 想确保我不会说出、做出什么让我们惹上麻烦的事。

lines.en: : You know, there was a thing out there I kind of wanted to check out.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,外面其实有一样东西,我本来有点想去看看。

lines.en: : That’s fine...I’ll...start putting my normal clothes back on now and we can head out...
lines.zh: : 好啊……那我就……把平时的衣服换回来,我们就出发……

lines.en: else:
scene amimalltwo25
: I wasn’t horny five minutes ago...
lines.zh: : 我五分钟前明明没有欲火焚身……

lines.en: : Why are you always getting horny in inconvenient locations?
lines.zh: : 你为什么总是会在这种不方便的地方发情?

lines.en: : Why are you always making me horny in inconvenient locations?
lines.zh: : 你为什么总是会在这种不方便的地方把我弄得发情?

lines.en: : I have done literally nothing. You need to learn self-control.
lines.zh: : 我什么都没做。你需要学学自控。

lines.en: : I need to learn self-control? You have sex with your [niece].
lines.zh: : 我需要学自控?你可是和自己的 [niece] 上床。

lines.en: : Not that I think that's a problem or anything, obviously.
lines.zh: : 当然,我不觉得那算什么问题。

lines.en: : Okay, we could both do with learning a little self control. But you are the culprit here and I am an innocent man trying to not sully the workplace of one of your peers.
lines.zh: : 好吧,咱俩都该学学自控。但这里 culprit 是你,而我是一个努力不玷污你同侪工作场所的无辜市民。

lines.en: : We can’t even sully it a little bit?
lines.zh: : 一点点都不行吗?

lines.en: : No, Ami.
lines.zh: : 不行,Ami。

lines.en: : Not even hand stuff?
lines.zh: : 手上的小事也不行?

lines.en: scene black
: Wait, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 等等,Sensei!

lines.en: : If I stay in there any longer, there will be no turning back.
lines.zh: : 我再多待一秒,就没有回头路了。

lines.en: : I don’t wanna turn back! I want you!
lines.zh: : 我不想回头!我想要你!

lines.en: I step into the front room again and wait for Ami to finish changing back into her normal clothes.
lines.zh: 我重新走到店面前厅,等 Ami 换回她平时的衣服。

lines.en: Chika is still stuck tending to the same customer as before, so I don’t have to awkwardly talk about “how things were in there” or whatever it was that she was definitely going to ask me.
lines.zh: Chika 还被之前那位客人缠着,所以我不用尴尬地跟她聊「里面怎么样」之类她铁定要问的话题。

lines.en: Ami returns a few minutes later with her new swimsuit in her hands and ultimately winds up getting rung up by one of the other employees.
lines.zh: 几分钟后 Ami 回来了,手里拿着新泳衣,最后由另一位店员帮她结的账。

lines.en: Neither of us say goodbye to Chika, but it’s not like we really had a chance to anyway.
lines.zh: 我们俩都没跟 Chika 道别,反正我们好像也没得到道别的机会。

lines.en: if ami_virgin == True:
scene black
Eventually, we board the bus and start heading home.
lines.zh: 最终,我们上了回程的公交,踏上归途。

lines.en: Ami brings up the prospect of the two of us going out to eat or something along those lines, but I refuse as there is something else I want to do with my day instead.
lines.zh: Ami 提议我们俩出去吃个饭什么的,我拒绝了——因为今天我还有别的事想干。

lines.en: Thankfully, we manage to get back into town shortly before nightfall and the two of us wind up amicably parting ways.
lines.zh: 所幸我们在入夜前赶回了镇上,两人愉快地道别。

lines.en: It wasn’t the most exciting or action packed of days I’ve spent with Ami, but it was still a fun one regardless.
lines.zh: 这算不上我和 Ami 相处的日子里最刺激或最跌宕的一天,但依然很有趣。

lines.en: Plus, she even got a new swimsuit out of it.
lines.zh: 更何况,她还因此收获了一件新泳衣。

lines.en: And I’m excited for not only that, but the prospect of everyone else who decides to buy swimsuits prior to our next trip to the beach...whenever that may be.
lines.zh: 让我期待的不只是这个,还有其他人会不会也在我们下次去海滩之前……不论那是何时——买下各自的泳装。

lines.en: $ ami_love += 1
$ amidate35 = True
$ amidorm40miss = True
Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]!

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
else:
Eventually, we board a bus and start heading home, but Ami decides that the day is not yet complete and that she wants to go out to eat with me.
lines.zh: 最终,我们还是上了公交踏上归途,但 Ami 觉得这一天还不够完整,想拉着我出去吃饭。

lines.en: I refuse at first but completely cave once she informs me that she’ll be paying for this as well.
lines.zh: 我起初拒绝,但一听说这顿也由她付钱,立刻全线投降。

lines.en: Listening to her happily hum the tune to one of Niki’s songs as it plays on the radio, I close my eyes and wait for whatever stop we're supposed to get off at to approach.
lines.zh: 电台里放着 Niki 的歌,她跟着旋律开心地哼着,我闭上眼睛,等着到站。

lines.en: scene amimalltwo26
: You know, you should probably eat more than just french fries, Ami.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,Ami,你不能光吃薯条。

lines.en: : But I love french fries.
lines.zh: : 可我爱薯条。

lines.en: : And I bought them with my own money, so it’s not like you can even say something like “Bahhh you’ll eat right under my roof!”
lines.zh: : 而且这是我用自己的钱买的,你总不能说什么「住我的屋檐下就得听我的」吧。

lines.en: : Also, this isn’t even your roof. Back off of my french fries.
lines.zh: : 再说了,这也不是你的屋檐。离我的薯条远点。

lines.en: : I was...unaware that you felt so strongly about them.
lines.zh: : 我……没想到你对薯条有这么深的执念。

lines.en: scene amimalltwo27
: Did you have fun today, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 今天开心吗,Sensei?

lines.en: : I know it wasn’t like an actual date since we’re always spending time together and stuff...but I really like getting to do things like this with you.
lines.zh: : 我知道这算不上真正的约会,毕竟我们反正天天黏在一起什么的……但我真的很喜欢和你做这种事。

lines.en: : You know...being out in public. Trying on clothes for you. Eating stuff together.
lines.zh: : 你懂的……一起出门。为你试衣服。一起吃东西。

lines.en: : It’s kind of like we’re in a real relationship. Or at least what I imagine a real relationship feels like.
lines.zh: : 感觉就像我们在真正地交往。或者至少,像我想象中真正交往的感觉。

lines.en: : I guess it does kind of feel like a relationship when you put it that way.
lines.zh: : 你这么一说,确实有点像是在交往。

lines.en: scene amimalltwo28
: Right?! And wasn’t it lots of fun?!
lines.zh: : 对吧!而且超级好玩对不对?!

lines.en: : Sure. It was a lot of fun. I won’t deny that.
lines.zh: : 对。确实很好玩。我不否认。

lines.en: scene amimalltwo29
: Then make it official and start dating me for real.
lines.zh: : 那就让它名正言顺,真正跟我交往吧。

lines.en: : You know I can’t do that.
lines.zh: : 你知道这不可能。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : Do you really need to ask? There are hundreds of reasons.
lines.zh: : 你真要问吗?理由有几百个。

lines.en: : And there are hundreds of reasons you should do it.
lines.zh: : 而理由也有几百个,支持你答应。

lines.en: : If you’re worried about everyone thinking it’s weird because we’re related, I don’t think you have to.
lines.zh: : 你要是担心大家因为「我们有血缘」而觉得怪,我觉得大可不必。

lines.en: : Sure, people will probably think it’s weird at first, but once they see how happy we are, I’m sure they’ll be fine with it.
lines.zh: : 当然,一开始大家多半会觉得怪,但只要看到我们有多幸福,我相信他们会接受的。

lines.en: : You think just seeing two people happy together is enough to support them?
lines.zh: : 你觉得光是看见两个人幸福地在一起,就足以让人支持他们了吗?

lines.en: : Sure? Why not.
lines.zh: : 当然?为什么不。

lines.en: : So if I started dating someone else and looked happy with them, you’d support it?
lines.zh: : 那如果我去和别人交往,并且看起来很幸福,你也会支持?

lines.en: scene amimalltwo30
: Nope!
: See what I mean?
lines.zh: : 看到没?

lines.en: : Nope! Cause I also know you can’t be happy with anyone else.
lines.zh: : 不算!因为我也知道,你和别的任何人在一起都不可能幸福。

lines.en: : You and me are gonna be together forever cause that’s how things are meant to be.
lines.zh: : 你和我注定要永远在一起,因为事情本来就该这样。

lines.en: : And we’re gonna buy tons more bathing suits and eat tons more french fries because we both think those things are fun and we love each other very, very much.
lines.zh: : 我们还会买好多好多泳衣、吃好多好多薯条,因为我们俩都觉得这些事很有趣,而且我们非常非常相爱。

lines.en: scene amimalltwo31
: And if anyone ever tries to ruin that, I will do horrible things to them.
lines.zh: : 要是有人胆敢破坏这一切,我会对他们做出非常可怕的事。

lines.en: : You do realize that if “anyone tries to ruin that” it will be me, right?
lines.zh: : 你该意识到,要是「有人胆敢破坏这一切」,那个人只会是我,对吧?

lines.en: : You want to ruin me? Your adorable [niece]? Who cooks you breakfast every morning and lets you cum on her face?
lines.zh: : 你想毁掉我?毁掉你可爱的 [niece]?每天早上给你做早餐、任由你去在她脸上的 [niece]?

lines.en: : I don’t know what I want. But I know that a relationship isn’t anywhere near the top of the list.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己想要什么。但我知道,「交往」离那张清单的顶端还差得远。

lines.en: : But it will be one day, right?
lines.zh: : 但总有一天会排上去的,对吧?

lines.en: : I have no idea.
lines.zh: : 不知道。

lines.en: : It will be one day.
lines.zh: : 总有一天会的。

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: : It will be one day.
lines.zh: : 总有一天会的。

lines.en: I want to say something like “the restaurant goes quiet and an uncomfortable silence finds its way between us,” but Niki is on the radio in here as well.
lines.zh: 我很想说一句「餐馆安静了下来,一片令人不适的沉默在我们之间蔓延」,但这家店的电台里也在放 Niki 的歌。

lines.en: It’s like her voice has been following me all fucking day.
lines.zh: 她那声音就像他妈的跟了我一整天。

lines.en: Like it’s just seeping into my ears and criticizing me for going on a date with my [niece] and not pushing her away the same way I would with anyone else.
lines.zh: 像是一直渗进我的耳朵,指责我和 [niece] 约会,指责我没有像推开其他任何人那样推开她。

lines.en: For not telling her that “It won’t be one day.”
lines.zh: 指责我没有告诉她「那一天不会来」。

lines.en: And for being afraid to steal away her smile just because I know why it looks the way it does- held together by Scotch tape and glue.
lines.zh: 指责我不敢夺走她的微笑——只因我知道那笑容的成分:用透明胶带和胶水勉强粘在一起。

lines.en: : Do you want a french fry? They’re extra salty today.
lines.zh: : 要来根薯条吗?今天的特别咸。

lines.en: : French fries only exist when they’re extra salty. Any other time they’re just-
lines.zh: : 薯条只有在特别咸的时候才叫薯条。其他时候它们只是——

lines.en: : Rectangular potato strings. I know. Do you want one or not?
lines.zh: : 长方形的土豆条。我知道。你到底要不要?

lines.en: : Fine.
lines.zh: : 要吧。

lines.en: scene black
I take the fry from Ami.
lines.zh: 我从 Ami 手里接过那根薯条。

lines.en: And then ten more.
lines.zh: 然后又拿了十根。

lines.en: And then an entire order because apparently she knew I was going to do this.
lines.zh: 然后干脆接过了一整份——看来她早就料到我会这样。

lines.en: I might not want a relationship with her-
lines.zh: 我或许不想和她「交往」——

lines.en: But my god, would it be easy to have one.
lines.zh: 但天啊,如果想要,那简直是世界上最容易的事。
